name: PageHeader
summary: The head of a page: where it sits, its title, what it's for and where it comes from. Not for the app's identity (use TitleBar) or for headings inside a page (use Section).
a11y: Renders the page's only `h1`. The eyebrow is a link with a 44 px target around its badge, underlined on hover and press. Long paths wrap anywhere instead of widening the page.

keys.action: reaches the eyebrow link, then the source link

props.name: title
props.description: The page's title: the one level-1 heading on the page.

props.name: lead
props.description: One or two sentences: what the page is for.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Where the page sits, as a badge linking back to its section.

props.name: source
props.description: Where the page's content comes from, as a link.

props.name: file
props.description: A source file path, shown as code under the lead.

props.name: titleData
props.description: `data-*` attributes for the title, for tooling such as revision anchors.

props.name: children
props.description: Anything else the head needs after the lead and sources, such as a note with a link.

props.name: newTab
props.description: Opens in a new browser tab (Link `newTab`).
